summary.tagline: A tranquil mountain park defined by industrial heritage and the magnificent dams of the Mourne landscape.

travel.headline: Check Local Trail Status for Silent Valley Access
travel.reservation: Entry typically involves a vehicle fee at the gate; official reservations for standard entry are not currently detailed in source text. Visitors must check the official NI Water site for temporary closures or landslip warnings that may impact trail availability.

days.title: Mourne Mountain Reservoirs and Heritage

stops.name: Silent Valley Mountain Park
stops.detail: Explore the industrial heritage and magnificent dams that shaped this mountain landscape. Follow available trails to experience the tranquility and beauty of the high Mournes.

days.driving: Allow 15-20 minutes from nearby coastal towns; conditions vary by weather.
days.note: The lower loop trail may be impacted by temporary closures; verify current map status upon arrival.

intel.title: Trail Safety
intel.text: The lower loop trail has experienced temporary closures due to a landslide. Always consult the map provided by NI Water to identify restricted red-highlighted zones.

intel.title: Heritage Exploration
intel.text: Allow ample time to learn about the dam construction history that defines the park's character. Morning visits typically offer the quietest experience in the valley.

intel.title: On-Site Facilities
intel.text: Parking is provided on-site at the mountain park entrance. Specific fill times are not documented, so verify local signage for any seasonal capacity limits.

intel.title: Connectivity Gap
intel.text: Mobile signal strength within the deep Mourne valley is not specified in official guides. Download maps and heritage information prior to entering the mountain area.

intel.title: Supply Availability
intel.text: There are no fuel stations within the park boundaries. Ensure your vehicle is serviced in gateway towns like Kilkeel before heading into the mountains.

plan.arrival: Pick up rental in Belfast or Dublin, travel toward the Mourne coast, and secure supplies in Kilkeel before entering the park.
plan.vehicle: Standard passenger cars are suitable for the paved access roads; check rental agreements for mountain road restrictions.
plan.goldenHour: Silent Valley Reservoir at sunset, though mountain shadows may fall early depending on the season.
